name: fluctuating winds
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
usage_note: 若原文讨论速度，使用 fluctuating wind velocity 对应“脉动风速”；不把 fluctuating wind 与 gust 自动互换。

complete_examples.text: As an example, the fluctuating winds can be obtained by applying the above method, as shown in Figure 4 (with 52 random samples).
It can be observed from Figure 5 that the PDFs of the fluctuating winds, which are derived from this method and MCM (with 1000 samples), respectively, coincide well with each other.
Due to the random-ness, spatial correlation, and time-varying characteristics of fluctuating winds, it is inevitably a key and complex task to characterize the nature of wind turbulence.
Therefore, the fluctuating winds should be properly considered if we want to accurately describe the car body vibrations.
The fluctuating winds are simulated using the modified spectral representation method with consideration of the spatial correlation of the fluctuating winds.

The Karhunen-Loève expansion method is applied to grasp the random features of fluctuating winds and the track random irregularities are generated by application of the track irregularity probabilistic model.
